summary: Iteration 17 validated the pre-production pass on Fate Passport. Backend: 25/25 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter17_passport_wall_and_stamping.py including CRUD (min 3 / max 10 stops), stamping (manual=verified false, gps<=0.4mi=verified true, gps too far=409, accuracy>300m=stamped+verified false+note), anti-cheat (two stamps <60s -> 429 'Slow down'; verified GPS with impossible 80mph travel -> 409 after a 62s sleep between stamps), holder ID page (name+jpeg data URL roundtrip, invalid data URL 422, /holder-photo returns image bytes), stop photos (409 before stamp, image bytes after), wall (GET /api/passports/wall NOT shadowed by /passports/{code}, returns only published items; POST /publish 409 when incomplete or not fully_verified; DELETE /publish idempotently unpublishes; /wall-thumb 404 when unpublished), unstamp (removes stamp and clears completed_at), and regressions (/api/places/search, /api/weather, /api/stats/fates, /api/stats/crawls all 200). Frontend (390x844 mobile viewport): Home renders, Skip intro works, passport-mode-toggle opens the passport-picker panel containing passport-type-picker + passport-type-picker-toggle chips, /wall link present, /wall renders wall-title + wall-grid with the legacy J9E3TR card, /p/J9E3TR loads scrolled to y=0 with passport-step-guide + guides 1/2/3 + steps 1/2/3 + passport-crest (transparent background — no black square) + holder-photo-picker + holder-name-input + holder-name-save + passport-publish + passport-award-open all present. Award reveal: passport-award-open renders passport-book-reveal with passport-cover-crest, then passport-award-image + passport-award-download + passport-book-close appear; passport-book-close hides the reveal. Assets: /logo-crest-gold.png, /logo-crest.png, /merch-front-dragon.jpg, /merch-front-subtle.jpg, /merch-front-cyber-subtle.jpg, /card-riffle.wav, /shuffle-dragon.wav all 200. /shop renders design cards. FAQ Home 'More' toggle (data-testid=faq-toggle) reveals faq-section containing the two required entries — 'What's the difference between a crawl and a Fate Passport?' and 'How does stamping a passport work — and can people fake it?'. Publish disabled logic verified via code review (/app/frontend/src/pages/Passport.jsx:631 -> disabled={awarding || (!data.published_at && !data.fully_verified)}) — the button is disabled precisely when a passport isn't yet published AND isn't fully GPS-verified, and stays clickable as an 'On the wall — remove' unpublish action for the legacy J9E3TR case (confirmed live). No console/page errors observed on any screen tested.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/pages/Home.jsx is now 1793 lines — was already flagged in iterations 15 & 16. FAQ list, passport panel, mode toggles, filters and SHUFFLE_LOOPS all live in one file. Splitting the FAQ + passport-picker into their own components would help future maintenance. Non-blocking.

Legacy already-published passport J9E3TR is fully manual (not fully_verified). It still renders on /wall (as expected, per the review note). If product wants the wall to hide legacy unverified rows going forward, either backfill fully_verified=true for J9E3TR or add a Mongo migration that unpublishes any historical passport where fully_verified is false. Currently it shows a 'VERIFIED ON SITE' green pill in the wall card — that pill on an unverified legacy passport is slightly misleading; consider gating the pill on fully_verified rather than published_at. Non-blocking.

The passport-publish button title tooltip only appears on hover (desktop). Mobile users won't see 'The wall is for passports stamped on site at every stop' when the button is greyed out. Consider surfacing the same message as an inline helper under the button when disabled. Minor UX polish, non-blocking.

backend/routes/passports.py::stamp_passport uses datetime.fromisoformat on last['stamped_at'] which can raise if a legacy stamp was written without tz info; the try/except swallows the error but silently sets elapsed=60 which then permits any stamp. Not exploitable today (all our writes are tz-aware ISO), but worth tightening to `elapsed = 0` on failure so a corrupted record errs on the safe side. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: The pytest suite creates ~10 short-lived TEST_ passports and deletes each one at the end of its class. One long-running test (impossible-travel) sleeps 62s. Legacy passport J9E3TR from iteration 15 was reused (read-only) to verify the award reveal + 'On the wall — remove' button behavior; nothing about it was modified. No production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fork·Fate is a React CRA web app (NOT Expo/React Native). Base URL: https://fate-mobile-build.preview.emergentagent.com — Cloudflare rejects requests without a browser User-Agent, so send `User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0` on every curl/python request. Backend URL env var is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Passport rules: min 3 / max 10 stops; 60s MIN_SECONDS_BETWEEN_STAMPS server-side (plan tests with `time.sleep(62)` between stamps OR create separate passports); GPS_STAMP_RADIUS_MILES=0.4; GPS_ACCURACY_LIMIT_M=300; MAX_TRAVEL_MPH=80. Wall requires completed_at AND fully_verified (409 otherwise). Legacy passport J9E3TR is 3-stops all-manual and pre-existing on the wall — that's expected legacy data, not a bug. Publish button disabled logic: `!published_at && !fully_verified`. Award reveal testIDs: passport-award-open -> passport-book-reveal -> passport-cover-crest + passport-award-image + passport-award-download + passport-book-close. Home passport-mode-toggle -> passport-picker panel with passport-type-picker + passport-type-picker-toggle chips.
